The subjects.

Inside a course

How a courseis organised.

A course is one topic, split into chapters. Inside each chapter, lessons are grouped by type so you can learn, then practise.

  • TheoryThe chapter taught from first principles.
  • Concept boostersShort videos on the ideas students get stuck on.
  • NEET DPPDaily practice problems for NEET.
  • Past papersNEET, GUJCET and GSEB previous-year questions, solved.
  • Notes & PDFsFormula sheets and study notes you can download.
